verified_facts.claim: The Public Utility Commission of Texas issued an Order Adopting New 16 TAC §25.194 in Project No. 58481, filed 9/18/2026.
The order requires a large load customer to post financial security in the amount $50,000 per megawatt (MW) before it can be included in an ERCOT interconnection study.
The order says the rule was adopted under PURA §37.0561 as enacted by Senate Bill 6 in the 89th Regular Legislative Session.
The order says the rule was proposed in the March 27, 2026 Texas Register and adopted with changes.
The order says the interconnecting DSP or TSP must return 20% of financial security when the large load customer energizes, and the remainder ratably in 20% increments as milestones are met.
The order refers to the batch zero interconnection study and to a commission action on June 18, 2026 that addresses batch zero eligibility and study requirements.
